chat.author: Michael Richardson
chat.text:
James Mozley said:

I assume the pre-cursor that (we hope) will die out a per the dinosaurs is per device policy?

The pre-cursor is a [or set, or consortium] vendor that produces at least one device, and one home gateway, and so can actually get something that works.  Otherwise, everyone waits for someone to go first.
